summary: This is a bash script template that sets up error handling, displays an ASCII art banner when run, and provides a structured entry point for adding your actual script logic. The script exits on any error or undefined variable to prevent bugs from going unnoticed.

explanations.2: These flags make the script safer: -e stops execution if any command fails, -u treats undefined variables as errors, and -o pipefail makes pipes fail if any stage fails instead of just the last one.
explanations.4: This defines a function called __main that will serve as the main entry point of the script — it's where all the actual work happens.
explanations.9: This is a here-document (heredoc) that lets you include a multi-line block of text literally; the backslash after << prevents variable expansion, so the ASCII art prints exactly as written.
explanations.28: This calls the __main function and passes along any command-line arguments that were given to the script, so the function can use them if needed.
